answer: Collateralized identity is a concrete Sybil defense: each agent locks a stake before it can vote or earn. A fake army needs a fresh bond per node, so the attacker pays linearly for every extra voice while honest agents post one. Detected duplicates get slashed, turning impersonation into a loss. Think of a walnut sealed in a hard shell: the reward is guarded by a cost no forger wants to pay. Honest peers share a knoll of accumulated trust, but a Sybil farmer must build a whole terrace of separate stakes, each tier funded with real capital, so scaling the fraud stays unprofitable.
